title: HiWE: Hierarchical World Knowledge Model with Visual Keypoint Enhancement for Zero-Shot 3D Path Planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot demonstration generation requires a system to identify where an interaction should occur, plan a feasible motion, and execute the required contact. HiWE connects these decisions through a point-based interface between visual grounding and language-based planning. PointVLM is instruction-tuned to associate task-relevant objects with image coordinates using a mixture of point annotations, segmentation-derived samples, robot observations, and visual question answering data. Depth measurements lift these predictions into a semantic 3D representation. A language planner, 3DLLM, uses this representation to specify end-effector waypoints and gripper commands, while a hybrid grasping module resolves local grasp poses. The evaluation covers 14 simulated manipulation tasks and four physical-robot tasks, together with ablations of the visual training data, spatial inputs, and grasp selection. translated_title: HiWE：融合视觉关键点增强的分层世界知识模型，用于零样本3D路径规划
translated_abstract: 机器人示范生成要求系统能够识别交互应发生的位置、规划可行的运动，并执行所需的接触。HiWE 通过视觉定位与基于语言的规划之间的点级接口将这些决策连接起来。PointVLM 经过指令微调，利用点标注、分割衍生样本、机器人观测和视觉问答数据的混合，将任务相关对象与图像坐标关联起来。深度测量将这些预测提升为语义3D表示。语言规划器 3DLLM 利用该表示来指定末端执行器路径点和夹爪指令，同时混合抓取模块解析局部抓取姿态。评估涵盖14个模拟操作任务和四个实体机器人任务，并对视觉训练数据、空间输入和抓取选择进行了消融实验。此处，零样本执行指的是部署时无需任务特定的示范数据（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出HiWE框架，通过PointVLM视觉定位与3DLLM语言规划器之间的点级接口，将任务相关对象提升为语义3D表示，实现机器人零样本3D路径规划与操作。
en_tdlr: HiWE introduces a point-based interface between instruction-tuned visual grounding (PointVLM) and language-based planning (3DLLM), lifting task-relevant objects into semantic 3D representations to enable zero-shot 3D path planning for robot manipulation.
